items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 17 at 2:39PM EDT until October 21 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt and seas 8 to 13 ft
expected.

* WHERE...Biscayne Bay, Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to
Ocean Reef FL out 20 NM and Waters from Deerfield Beach to
Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM excluding the territorial
waters of Bahamas.

* WHEN...From 2 AM Sunday to 8 PM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
